course.title: Corrosion and Surface Engineering
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: In plating a continuous strip of 1 m long and 0.9 m wide with Sn from an acid solution (valence (10) charge 2), the desired strip speed is 500 m/min, current efficiency is 100% and the thickness of Sn is to be 0.4 μm (each side) at a current density of 5000 $A / m ^ { 2 }$ .How long must the plating tank be, assuming that the strip passes straight though the tank with no returns bends? (ρsn=7.31 g/cc, Asn=118.7).

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
